name: Soft Drink War
description: Capture the Metropolis soft-drink market while growing a valuable company. Two rivals want the same aisle: one reacts to every price you set, the other undercuts on volume. Share counts real bottles sold over the last three months, so a cheap price that leaves shelves empty will not get you there.

goals.description: Sell 55% of all soft drinks bought in Metropolis (trailing three months). Combine several well-placed stores, a strong brand and competitive prices.
Grow company value to $150M. Market share bought with losses does not count toward value — the business has to earn more than its cost of capital.
